python_code:
async def act(page):
    # Locate all issue links by filtering for those with href starting with '/primer/design/issues/'
    issue_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has=page.get_by_role('link', name=lambda name: name and name.startswith('/primer/design/issues/')))
    # Get all the issue titles (inner texts) as a list
    issue_titles = await issue_links.all_inner_texts()
    # Return the list of issue titles as-is
    return issue_titles
